That's all for now, for more information about the game please [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]visit the Thieves Of Dingirra's campaign page[/url]!

notes.title: Thieves Of Dingirra crowdfunding!
notes.content:
Greetings all,
We’re thrilled to unveil the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]crowdfunding campaign[/url] for our upcoming fantasy game, "Thieves of Dingirra." This title blends town management, RPG mechanics, and, of course, visual novel elements with romance.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/ecb59186b4f5d6ee76f11feb716e982bf6f4c4f6.jpg[/img]
The core experience is designed to be approachable and casual, ensuring it’s not overwhelming, while still delivering strong replay value through numerous random events. RPG battles are limited to a set number, eliminating the need for grinding. 
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/4fa8ac2a0a0ada528139401e812cad46b23d61fd.jpg[/img]

You’ll still have the freedom to equip your party, choose skills, and assign attributes during level-ups, but the focus remains on a curated sequence of missions—no endless farming required.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/19621ae33bc1d3317da5860ed2793ee5f37b18bd.jpg[/img]
These missions unfold in a rogue-like fashion, featuring a map of various locations within a target building. Each spot presents unique possibilities: a skirmish, a trap, a hidden treasure, a captive to free, and more. Strategic party and inventory management will be key—pack too many healing potions, and you’ll leave less room for stolen loot.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/b24cddcced84c4349f1165bfdd28a97400298c31.jpg[/img]
On the romance front, the game offers six love interests for your male or female protagonist to pursue with two bisexual furry characters.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/e62d66c761f5b322365bced5ddbc4f7c146e49ff.jpg[/img]
For a deeper dive, visit our Kickstarter page:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra[/url]

Or add the game to your Steam wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/617990/Thieves_Of_Dingirra/

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New crowdfunding campaign for yuri visual novel: Christine's Care
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
we just launched a new Kickstarter campaign for a new slice of life yuri visual novel called Christine's Care:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/f9127f55bb3e2f37d8f888f790c8f12eb81f6b78.jpg[/img][/url]

Check the campaign page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0[/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/44d6e77f768ef91a16e87207df96a83e0a85935c.jpg[/img][/url]
Set in early 2000s Canada, this yuri visual novel follows Christine, a nurse reeling from a recent breakup with her boyfriend. Still nursing emotional wounds, Christine is assigned to care for Hannah, a patient just a few months older than herself who became paralyzed from the waist down after a car accident.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/49a6a3c9881a5e1a259b48f79534948807b0c052.jpg[/img][/url]
Although Hannah has been labeled as a difficult and "problematic" patient, Christine is immediately captivated by her personality. Beneath her sharp edges, Christine finds Hannah's outlook on life refreshingly unique, marked by wit and surprising depth. Despite frequent bouts of depression and anger caused by her condition, Hannah's sense of humor helps her navigate the darkest moments. She's also exceptionally talented, with a knack for playing the guitar and a gift for singing that reveals a quieter, more soulful side.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/c44551c833a88e88d60901cca0445f9ccb957316.jpg[/img][/url]
As Christine spends more time caring for Hannah, she begins to see past her own heartache. The bond between them deepens, and Christine finds herself slowly falling in love with Hannah, awakening feelings she had never explored before—her attraction to another woman, and a new understanding of her own sexuality.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/9021bdaeaffc3701d37ec3b6a1aa827333e14d0c.jpg[/img][/url]
At the same time, Christine crosses paths with an intriguing couple, Marlon and Liz. Marlon, a muscular Latina bodybuilder, exudes strength and confidence, while Liz, her slender Asian partner, contrasts with a quieter, more delicate presence. The couple shares a dominant-submissive dynamic, with Marlon firmly in control.

One evening, Marlon, sensing Christine’s curiosity, invites her to step into a more dominant role with Liz. Hesitant at first, Christine agrees, and to her surprise, she finds herself deeply enjoying the experience—perhaps even more than she anticipated. In the days that follow, Liz begins openly flirting with Christine, subtly suggesting that she might be interested in a new dominant figure. The offer is tempting, but Christine knows that Marlon is not someone to cross lightly.

As Christine navigates these new desires, the tension between her feelings for Hannah and her growing fascination with Marlon and Liz threatens to pull her in conflicting directions, forcing her to confront parts of herself she had never acknowledged.

notes.title: House of Chavez coming to Steam the 22nd April!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
we're pleased to announce that after a good amount of beta testing, our new psychological horror, yuri visual novel / adventure game "House of Chavez" is coming out on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965960/House_Of_Chavez/

the game is planned to go live the 22nd of this month!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/d416517aadeebcc53bbdfd8fc8c1d4185fdec436.jpg[/img]
The game will have two characters you can fall in love with, Dolores and Silke. They are both different in how they act and look, and they each have secrets from their pasts. Can you uncover their secrets and finish the story with them still alive?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/d295b96e002b6fcb70ff667231f82192576d1785.jpg[/img]
Based on feedback from beta testers, we have added two difficulty modes. In Easy (the default) you can skip the minigames immediately, while in Normal you can skip them only after you fail them three times.
Of course, the game is an adventure game so there will be puzzles to solve and things to interact with in the environment. If players get stuck, a game guide will be published to help them out.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/540681bba633fb11456144effb99a9c7e5d9a6ec.jpg[/img]
Last but not least, the game will feature several spooky situations and scenes, relying more on the psychological aspect, the fear of the unknown, , rather than showing lots of blood and violence.

We're excited for you to play the game when it comes out! In the meantime, you can add it to your wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965960/House_Of_Chavez/

notes.title: ToA: An Elven Marriage Kickstarter is live
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

I'm excited to announce that the crowdfunding campaign for my upcoming fantasy RPG, "An Elven Marriage," is now live on Kickstarter!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-of-aravorn-an-elven-marriage?ref=8eu0vm][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/6918cb57c6a91fe3b4485c4132e78a4bfbd94093.jpg[/img][/url]

In "An Elven Marriage," you will once again step into the shoes of Saren/Elenor and embark on a thrilling journey to the city of Triberg. Joining you on this adventure are both familiar faces and new allies, who will accompany you on your quest.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-of-aravorn-an-elven-marriage?ref=8eu0vm][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/f0cd3948c315ce6d5c605a865da3ebe1760c77d3.jpg[/img][/url]

Immerse yourself in the grand event of the Elven Marriage between Lydia and Marian from Paqwana, hoping that everything proceeds smoothly. But beware! Forces such as Jul and Zeal are determined to disrupt the joyous occasion and have their own nefarious plans in motion.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-of-aravorn-an-elven-marriage?ref=8eu0vm][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/9a37fd6ee9fde134c2f605b13c651542ec9bf754.jpg[/img][/url]

This game offers four captivating love interests, allowing you to navigate intricate relationships and make tough choices that will shape the course of your story. With a branching plotline, full-fledged RPG gameplay, and an entirely new region to explore, complete with diverse locations and intriguing sidequests, "An Elven Marriage" promises an immersive and unforgettable experience.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-of-aravorn-an-elven-marriage?ref=8eu0vm]Check the Kickstarter page now![/url]

notes.title: Save the World coming on Steam tomorrow
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that our new sci-fi yuri visual novel "Save the World" is coming to Steam tomorrow!

Wishlist it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2280370/Save_The_World/

To be honest, this game theme may generate a fair amount of controversy. It tells a story that, in my opinion, will be polarizing - it's either going to be adored or despised. This isn't an anti-rich or anti-capitalist tirade; instead, it's a thought-provoking narrative designed to prompt reflections on the extravagance and disputes of the contemporary era. 

Regardless, I sincerely hope that you'll try it once it's released and share your thoughts!

notes.title: New Kickstarter announcement - Save The World
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/jz4oi9nFJVc

We're excited to introduce a Kickstarter for a captivating sci-fi visual novel called "[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/save-the-world-1?ref=293p8s]Save The World[/url]". This story follows protagonist Ekiya, who is a young Indian living in London with her childhood friend Sarah, and fighting to cope with life. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/save-the-world-1?ref=293p8s][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/c8a713993155bf0f34966f2098cee0a85ce6ec56.jpg[/img][/url]

One day, aliens arrive and pull Ekiya on board. Xen, the non-binary alien leader, inquires what is wrong with the world and Ekiya mentions the vast inequality of wealth and power. This sparks a radical and world-altering response that Ekiya will have to handle. But, seeing this as an opportunity, she may be able to engineer even more global changes as well.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/save-the-world-1?ref=293p8s][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/8dd510b03dd287c696cad9d47c322a6e1458d94c.jpg[/img][/url]

This extraordinary adventure will have players questioning the notion of good and evil as they see the situation through Ekiya's eyes. Can they save the world? Or will they succumb to the same fate they are trying to avoid? 

"[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/save-the-world-1?ref=293p8s]Save the World[/url]" is an immersive game filled with suspense and romance. Players are presented with two distinct love interests – Xen and Sarah – and four possible endings. The story twists and turns in unexpected directions, and thoughtful decisions must be made in order to reach the best conclusion.

notes.title: New Kickstarter announcement - Tales From The Under-Realm: After Midnight
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new Kickstarter! It's the new game in the Tales From The Under-Realm series, called "After Midnight".
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/1dec22a84c2b05758c0aa1b6cd69d62dc5c937d6.jpg[/img][/url]

This time, the game takes the form of a murder-mystery. Indeed, the Nameless God will peek into the past of a young guard of the city of Lothark, under the command of Captain Samael.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/e4fcae73e56ba979a6ae36fa9cc7f6762bbb7e9e.jpg[/img][/url]

A series of murders will hit the town, all happening after midnight. Will our protagonist be one of the victim? How did she die?

You'll be able to customize the character name and also the skin color and hair (it's a stretch goal but should be possible).
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/d91ab32361f3128fe6be7680f52a3f06837499db.jpg[/img][/url]

Once again there will be two different love interests: Tara, the protagonist's childhood friend and fellow  guard, or Cynthia, the mysterious newcomer from Dingirra.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/be7234981f6929c597254737c086632b902d4f8c.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/b81abdb113a18abe765e89b1218e1e5879872c73.jpg[/img][/url]
While it will be always possible to reach an happy ending with your love interest, the story will be even darker than Hazel, with many possible character deaths.

If you like the idea, visit the official Kickstarter page to know more:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/tales-from-the-under-realm-after-midnight
